provenance: Captured from the installed pinned Spotify MCP through its real SDK Client with mocked HTTP and in-memory credentials. No real Spotify requests or writes.

tools.name: searchSpotify
tools.description: Search for tracks, albums, artists, playlists, podcast episodes, or shows on Spotify. For episodes and shows, the query matches against title, description, and publisher. Use type "episode" to find individual podcast episodes by topic or guest name, and type "show" to find podcast series.

query.description: The search query. Matches title, description, and publisher for podcasts.

type.description: The type of item to search for: track, album, artist, playlist, episode (podcast episode), or show (podcast series)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 10)

offset.description: Index of the first result to return (default: 0). Combine with limit to page past the first 10 results.

tools.name: getNowPlaying
tools.description: Get information about the currently playing track on Spotify, including device and volume info

tools.name: getMyPlaylists
tools.description: Get a list of the current user's playlists on Spotify

limit.description: Maximum number of playlists to return (1-50)

tools.name: getPlaylistTracks
tools.description: Get a list of tracks in a Spotify playlist

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

tools.name: getRecentlyPlayed
tools.description: Get a list of recently played tracks on Spotify

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

tools.name: getUsersSavedTracks
tools.description: Get a list of tracks saved in the user's "Liked Songs" library

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

tools.name: removeUsersSavedTracks
tools.description: Remove one or more tracks from the user's "Liked Songs" library (max 40 per request)

trackIds.description: Array of Spotify track IDs to remove (max 40)

tools.name: getQueue
tools.description: Get a list of the currently playing track and the next items in your Spotify queue

limit.description: Maximum number of upcoming items to show (1-50)

tools.name: getAvailableDevices
tools.description: Get information about the user's available Spotify Connect devices

tools.name: getTopTracks
tools.description: Get the current user's top (most-played) tracks over a given time range. This is the closest thing Spotify exposes to listening statistics.

timeRange.description: Time range: short_term (~4 weeks), medium_term (~6 months), or long_term (~1 year). Default: medium_term.

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

tools.name: getTopArtists
tools.description: Get the current user's top (most-played) artists over a given time range. This is the closest thing Spotify exposes to listening statistics.

timeRange.description: Time range: short_term (~4 weeks), medium_term (~6 months), or long_term (~1 year). Default: medium_term.

limit.description: Maximum number of artists to return (1-50)

tools.name: playMusic
tools.description: Start playing a Spotify track, album, artist, or playlist. Pass a Spotify URI (e.g. spotify:track:xxx, spotify:album:xxx) via "uri". For albums/playlists you can also use "context_uri". Device is selected automatically — "deviceId" or "device_id" are optional.

uri.description: Spotify URI to play (e.g. spotify:track:xxx, spotify:album:xxx)

context_uri.description: Alias for uri — Spotify context URI for albums/playlists

type.description: Type of item (only needed with id)

id.description: Spotify ID of the item (use with type)

deviceId.description: Spotify device ID to play on (auto-selected if omitted)

tools.name: pausePlayback
tools.description: Pause Spotify playback on the active device

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to pause playback on

tools.name: skipToNext
tools.description: Skip to the next track in the current Spotify playback queue

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to skip on

tools.name: skipToPrevious
tools.description: Skip to the previous track in the current Spotify playback queue

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to skip on

tools.name: createPlaylist
tools.description: Create a new playlist on Spotify

public.description: Whether the playlist should be public

tools.name: addTracksToPlaylist
tools.description: Add tracks or podcast episodes to a Spotify playlist. Accepts Spotify track IDs, episode IDs, or full Spotify URIs (e.g. spotify:episode:xxx).

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

trackIds.description: Array of Spotify IDs or URIs to add. Plain IDs are assumed to be tracks. To add podcast episodes, pass full URIs: spotify:episode:{id}.

position.description: Position to insert the items (0-based index)

tools.name: resumePlayback
tools.description: Resume Spotify playback on the active device

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to resume playback on

tools.name: addToQueue
tools.description: Adds a track, album, artist or playlist to the playback queue

uri.description: The Spotify URI to play (overrides type and id)

type.description: The type of item to play

id.description: The Spotify ID of the item to play

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to add the track to

tools.name: setVolume
tools.description: Set the playback volume to a specific percentage (0-100). Requires Spotify Premium.

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to set volume on

tools.name: adjustVolume
tools.description: Adjust the playback volume up or down by a relative amount. Use positive values to increase, negative to decrease. Requires Spotify Premium.

adjustment.description: The amount to adjust volume by (-100 to 100). Positive increases, negative decreases.

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to adjust volume on

tools.name: getAlbums
tools.description: Get detailed information about one or more albums by their Spotify IDs

albumIds.description: A single album ID or array of album IDs (max 20)

tools.name: getAlbumTracks
tools.description: Get tracks from a specific album with pagination support

albumId.description: The Spotify ID of the album

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

tools.name: saveOrRemoveAlbumForUser
tools.description: Save or remove albums from the user's "Your Music" library

action.description: Action to perform: save or remove albums

tools.name: checkUsersSavedAlbums
tools.description: Check if albums are saved in the user's "Your Music" library

albumIds.description: Array of Spotify album IDs to check (max 20)

tools.name: getPlaylist
tools.description: Get details of a specific Spotify playlist including tracks count, description and owner

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

tools.name: updatePlaylist
tools.description: Update the details of a Spotify playlist (name, description, public/private, collaborative)

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

public.description: Whether the playlist should be public

collaborative.description: Whether the playlist should be collaborative (requires public to be false)

tools.name: removeTracksFromPlaylist
tools.description: Remove one or more tracks from a Spotify playlist (max 100 tracks per request)

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

trackIds.description: Array of Spotify track IDs to remove (max 100)

snapshotId.description: The playlist snapshot ID to target a specific version (optional)

tools.name: reorderPlaylistItems
tools.description: Reorder a range of tracks within a Spotify playlist by moving them to a new position

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

rangeStart.description: The position of the first item to move (0-based index)

insertBefore.description: The position where the items should be inserted (0-based index)

rangeLength.description: Number of consecutive items to move (defaults to 1)

snapshotId.description: The playlist snapshot ID to target a specific version (optional)

tools.name: unfollowPlaylist
tools.description: Remove a playlist from the current user's library (unfollow). Note: Spotify does not allow permanent deletion of playlists via the API.

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist to unfollow
